description.zh-CN: 从清单与流量 CSV 生成 MONITOR 候选策略审查稿；不连接或修改 Everoute。
description.en-US: Generate MONITOR policy review drafts from inventory and traffic CSV. No live Everoute operations.

compatibility.tower: Candidate UI target: CloudTower 4.9.0; native workpage acceptance pending. No live Everoute policy operations.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: 0.1.4 开发候选：由插件声明安全策略转换入口与页面，消费通用 UI contributions v1，移除旧工作页字段。最低框架 0.2.6；真实入口待验收，仅离线转换和审查稿导出。
releaseNotes.en-US: 0.1.4 development candidate: plugin-owned navigation and page declarations using UI contributions v1, replacing the prototype workPage field. Requires framework 0.2.6. Native acceptance pending; offline review export only.
